description: Took ownership of the commission system end to end: requirements, project management, technical scoping, front-end, back-end, database and deployment.
Kept the commission system that pays our agents accurately and on time, and led its migration from Laravel to Node.js with Docker and modern AI tooling.
Learned Robotic Process Automation with a remote team through UiPath Academy, and wrote the shipment tracking and competitive analysis scripts for Vitamix.
Assisted in executing events, creating media, and organizing social media of the Global Ambassador student organization at Penn State Harrisburg.
Worked under Math and Computer Science faculty to grade assignments and proctor quizzes of Penn State Harrisburg undergraduate students.
Tested and automated Altea, the inventory product 100+ airlines run on. Revamped its test framework with a colleague to cut execution time by 40%, and sat on the product's security assessment team.
Research for SCADA Intrusion Detection System using ELK Stack.
Developed and tested "Mixed Reality" apps for Microsoft Hololens using Unity3D.
